creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Without an integrator handing out work, two agents can both read `kan ready` and start the same card. Kan shouldn't require an integrator.

Starting sketch in `docs/design/work-across-boards.md`, section "Deferred": a claim is the atomic move from an open column into an active one, recording the holder and an expiry. Open: the default expiry and how renewal works, how a stale claim shows on the board and in `kan ready`, what a manual drag into an active column means, and whether to leave a hook for a central lock, since plain files can't make a claim atomic across machines.
title: Design: claims, so parallel agents don't take the same card
